propertyEvents.locator: PDF pages 1-12; the operating account reconciliation for each month end

propertyEvents.result: All 12 were prepared by Marisol Zielinski within 15 days of month end and each reconciles to the cent. June 30: $5,554,191.74 per the bank, less 9 outstanding payments of $192,506.43, is the books’ $5,361,685.31, the trial balance’s operating cash. None of the twelve is signed as reviewed (Q7): CLS-2 is in place but its review is not evidenced (REC-01), the same gap the cash audit found in the company’s June reconciliation.

propertyEvents.result: 30 entries ($8,045,083) posted without review (JE-01) · 12 reconciliations on time, none signed as reviewed (REC-01)
Ready for the Lender and the Board
Rate each key control and propose a severity for each deficiency

4 of 11 key controls are designed and operating effectively: P2P-3, B2C-1, B2C-2, PAY-3. Four deficiencies: SOD-01 and JE-01 proposed as significant deficiencies, PAY-01 and REC-01 as deficiencies. No misstatement was found in what was tested, but $8,045,083.44 of entries and $64,675.50 of payments went through without the second person the policy requires. The CPA decides every level and considers whether SOD-01 and JE-01 together are a material weakness.

Ready for the Lender and the Board
Rate each key control and propose a severity for each deficiency

4 of 11 key controls are designed and operating effectively: P2P-3, B2C-1, B2C-2, PAY-3. Four deficiencies: SOD-01 and JE-01 proposed as significant deficiencies, PAY-01 and REC-01 as deficiencies. No misstatement was found in what was tested, but $8,045,083.44 of entries and $64,675.50 of payments went through without the second person the policy requires. The CPA decides every level and considers whether SOD-01 and JE-01 together are a material weakness.
